responsibility: Provides the IR-independent core implementation of GCC’s control-flow graph container and primitive mutation routines. It initializes and frees per-function CFG state, allocates and links basic blocks, creates/removes/redirects edges at the data-structure level, compacts block numbering, manages per-block auxiliary storage, updates profile counts/probabilities for threaded edges and block scaling, and maintains original/copy maps for duplicated blocks and loops; higher-level RTL, GIMPLE, loop, and cleanup code build on these generic CFG services rather than manipulating block and edge vectors directly.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable implementation of the generic, IR-independent CFG container and primitive block/edge mutation routines, including allocation, linking, redirection, compaction, profile scaling, and original/copy maps; unlike gcc/cfg.h, which only declares the control_flow_graph data structure, APIs, and temporary-flag helpers.
